name: nextcloud-for-chatgpt-codex
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to a user-owned Nextcloud workspace through a tenant-isolated MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Work safely with files in your own Nextcloud workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect a user-owned Nextcloud account, browse and search files, make explicitly requested file changes, and review household invoices inside a user-selected workspace root. Bridge identity and Nextcloud credentials stay separate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the files at the top level of my connected Nextcloud workspace.
